items.title: Lovart intègre Nano Banana Pro, adossé à une promo par DM
items.synopsis: Le post annonce l'intégration de Nano Banana Pro dans Lovart, plateforme de design assisté, avec Kling O1 également mentionné. Le propos commercial domine : jusqu'à 50 % de réduction et un an d'accès illimité sans crédits, en échange d'un commentaire déclencheur de DM, avec une date limite au 14 décembre. La revendication de remplacer Photoshop, Canva et Gemini n'est appuyée par aucune démonstration dans le texte.
items.author: adam.godigital

items.title: Un site de prompts Nano Banana poussé sans être nommé
items.synopsis: Reel de type enregistrez-ceci pointant vers un site web de prompts pour Nano Banana, le modèle image de Google. La légende est purement incitative (sauvegarder, partager, suivre) et les hashtags portent toute l'information de contexte. Ni le nom du site ni un exemple de prompt ne sont donnés dans le texte, le contenu utile restant dans la vidéo.
items.author: ui.johnson

items.title: Vol.1 d'un partage de prompts Midjourney, avec passage en Low Motion
items.synopsis: Publication coréenne qui diffuse une première série de prompts Midjourney prêts à l'emploi, présentés comme suffisants pour générer une image sans réglages supplémentaires. L'auteur enchaîne ensuite sur la fonction Low Motion de Midjourney pour animer l'image obtenue, ce qui fait du prompt un point de départ image puis vidéo. La distribution par DM est annoncée comme clôturée, une suite étant promise.
items.author: ai.favmag

items.title: Five small details that make an AI avatar read as real
items.synopsis: The creator's recurring finding is that avatar realism is never one big thing but an accumulation of tiny details. The five she watches most are skin, eyes, lighting and the small imperfections a real photograph would contain. An example prompt accompanies the breakdown so the difference is visible rather than described.
items.author: carrieparker.ai

items.title: Editorial-grade skin and grain in Midjourney
items.synopsis: AI now renders skin texture, lighting and colour grading convincingly enough to pass as an editorial shoot. The example leans on soft grain, golden tones and natural diffusion. The creator attributes the result to prompt control and lighting simulation inside Midjourney rather than post-processing.
items.author: afzanhilmi

items.title: Why realistic AI photos imitate real camera flaws
items.synopsis: Realistic AI photos come from understanding what real cameras actually capture, not from luck. The details that sell an image are slightly worn makeup, natural skin texture, small imperfections, authentic phone framing, loose hair strands and believable expressions. Together they make an image read as photographed rather than generated.
items.author: fash.studio_

items.title: The prompt, not the generator, decides AI realism
items.synopsis: The most common question is which AI image generator the creator uses, and that is almost never what determines the result. A hundred people given the same tool produce a hundred different images because the prompt does the heavy lifting. Generic prompts yield the waxy skin and lifeless faces flooding social media, so realism requires prompting explicitly for texture, imperfections, lighting and expression.
items.author: softlifeselena

items.title: Why AI photos look fake — and the realism layer that fixes it
items.synopsis: The creator argues that AI images look fake because of the prompt, not the model, and demonstrates with an image made in Arcads using GPT Image 2. Instead of simple descriptions he specifies exactly how a real photograph behaves — real camera settings, natural lighting, lifestyle framing — then adds a realism layer calling out visible pores, peach fuzz, baby hairs, subtle freckles, skin texture, fine wrinkles, natural lip texture, soft redness, and the tiny imperfections real cameras capture. A final pass through Skin Enhancer restores natural texture and removes the plastic AI look.
items.author: ai.akshu

items.title: Higgsfield + Nano Banana Pro Realistic Skin Recipe
items.synopsis: The post argues that fake-looking AI influencer photos are caused by weak prompts rather than weak models. Pairing Higgsfield with Nano Banana Pro yields images that pass as real iPhone photos with natural lighting and lifestyle framing. Realism is layered in with explicit prompt terms for skin texture, visible pores, and small imperfections.
items.author: ai.akshu

items.title: Imperfection Detail Makes AI Avatars Read as Real
items.synopsis: The creator explains that realism in current AI portraits comes from what older models smoothed out: natural skin flaws, uneven tone, tiny freckles, and peach fuzz. The brain reads these imperfections as proof the photo is genuine. Micro-detail in the eye completes the illusion, with the full prompt set gated behind an AI comment.
items.author: bymaximade

items.title: Perfect AI Skin Formula: Three Words Plus Magnific
items.synopsis: The creator's formula for fixing plastic-looking AI portraits starts with the prompt itself. Adding the three phrases visible pores, skin texture, and natural imperfections makes AI render skin like film photography instead of CGI. The second step is smart upscaling with Magnific to lock in the photoreal finish.
items.author: timkoda_

items.title: Generating a synthetic AI influencer through a Claude custom connector
items.synopsis: Hugo Matias opens by revealing the woman on screen is entirely AI-generated, then walks through reproducing her: copy an MCP server link, add it in the Claude settings as a custom connector, rename it and continue. A single prompt then returns a consistent AI influencer persona in about two minutes. The rest of the pitch is monetisation, posting the output to social platforms for reach and redirecting that traffic to a paid fan platform, with the full method gated behind a comment; the connector name is only spoken aloud, so the exact tool is not reliably identifiable from the video.
items.author: hugomatias.ai

items.title: Turning one talking-head take into an eight-camera studio shoot
items.synopsis: Nomada Toast demonstrates converting a single flat talking-head recording into footage that looks shot by a full studio camera rig. The workflow starts with a screenshot of the original take, runs it through an image generator to rebuild the scene as a professional studio, adding props with the pen tool or command-clicking to alter elements, then imports the original video alongside that still. Seedance 2.5 inside Lovart transforms the whole recording against the new reference, turning one shot into roughly eight distinct angles without reshooting.
items.author: nomadatoast

items.title: Free open-source cinematic video generation with sound
items.synopsis: The creator dropped paid AI video subscriptions after finding a free open-source alternative. It generates cinematic video with sound effects from either text or images. Camera movement, effects, styles and scenes are controllable, and running it locally removes any cap on generations.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: Sell cinematic 3D restaurant menus made from one prompt
items.synopsis: The pitch is packaging AI-generated 3D menus as a premium digital product for restaurants. The workflow uploads photos of an existing menu to Google Flow, then pastes a single detailed prompt to produce the 3D effect. The output turns a flat menu into a cinematic animation with realistic detail and smooth transitions, ready to resell to multiple restaurants.
items.author: kushalfinds.ai

items.title: MiniMax H3 outputs 2K video with stereo audio in one pass
items.synopsis: China open-sourced MiniMax H3, an AI video model producing 2K video and stereo audio in a single pass. It combines video, speech, lip sync and music without stitching separate tools together. The licence permits commercial use.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: Collage-style motion design with ChatGPT and Seedance
items.synopsis: A French walkthrough for producing collage-poster motion graphics using ChatGPT and Seedance 2.5. You first generate a still in ChatGPT describing the collage poster style, optionally importing a reference image to match, then ask ChatGPT to write a video prompt specifying that the animation starts on a blank canvas and reveals each collage element layer by layer. Pasting that prompt into Seedance with the reference image turns the still into a finished motion design animation.
items.author: antony_nonis

items.title: Generate a new camera angle from a single image
items.synopsis: A French demo of an AI tool that converts any single image into a new camera angle in about thirty seconds. No editing software and no cost are involved. The creator uses it to fake convincing camera movement in video projects.
items.author: jeremy_ia

items.title: Claude Code edits raw footage into DaVinci Resolve
items.synopsis: The creator hands raw video to Claude Code and gets a finished edit back in one click. The result lands directly in DaVinci Resolve ready to review. The pitch is removing both the editing subscription and the hired editor from the loop.
items.author: leon.petrou

items.title: MiniMax H3 run locally against Seedance 2.0
items.synopsis: A head-to-head comparison between a free AI video model and Seedance 2.0. The team runs MiniMax H3 locally on a Dell Precision T2 tower using prompts and reference images supplied by Higgsfield. The point is showing what a local workstation delivers versus a hosted commercial model.
items.author: badxstudio

items.title: A product ad from one image, storyboarded by AI
items.synopsis: A setup for producing a professional-looking product commercial with no ad budget. One product image is expanded into a nine-panel storyboard, then animated. The output is a finished ad ready to post.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: Cutting social clips from three-hour podcasts
items.synopsis: Chat Video Pro is a plugin for extracting social clips from very long podcast recordings. It removes the subscription model, with each cut costing pennies. The creator frames it as a way for agencies to deliver more client value faster.
items.author: chatvideopro

items.title: Reviewing Claude Code video edits on a here.now page
items.synopsis: The creator edits entire videos with Claude Code, including motion graphics and captions, but found reviewing the cut miserable inside a chat window. Now Claude spins up a here.now page where the video can be watched and commented on at every timestamp needing a change. Claude then reads the feedback and builds the next version; here.now is made by Vercel and has its own agent integration.
items.author: mr.paidsocial

items.title: A full video from a single prompt with Seedance 2.5 on Morphic
items.synopsis: The creator made an entire video from one prompt using Seedance 2.5 inside Morphic Studios. The workflow is to open Morphic, select Seedance 2.5, add references, paste the prompt, and generate. The model supports 30-second single-shot videos, up to 50 references, and extending existing videos.
items.author: ai.akshu

items.title: Three rules that keep AI video out of slop territory
items.synopsis: The creator argues the fastest route to AI slop is forcing one model to do every job, and instead maps tasks to models: Soul 2.0 for realism, Soul Cinema for cinematic frames, GPT 2.0 for text-heavy images, and Nano Banana 2.0 for general editing. Second, he says to prompt as if on set with an infinite budget — name the camera, the lens, the director whose eye you want, and the film the shot should feel like, because the real bottleneck is your film vocabulary rather than the tool. Third, add organic texture such as film grain, halation, and bloom, since AI output is too clean and lacks the sensor noise and lens imperfection a real camera introduces.
items.author: buck.the.aikami

items.title: AICameraControl poses a 3D model to lock the exact camera shot for AI images
items.synopsis: The creator demonstrates using 3D models to obtain the exact shot and pose you want in AI images, starting at AICameraControl.com where you position the camera, move and rotate the model, add a second person, and adjust the pose down to individual body parts. Once the shot looks right you pick your image model, tick character sheet, and hit generate, which returns both the prompt and a reference frame to download. You then upload those into an image model such as Nano Banana Pro alongside your character sheet, and the generated image retains the pose and framing of the reference.
items.author: benkaluza.tech

items.title: yt-dlp downloads video from 1,700+ sites and pairs well with Claude
items.synopsis: The creator highlights yt-dlp as one of the most powerful and under-discussed GitHub repositories, with over 183,000 stars putting it in the top twenty repos worldwide. It downloads from more than 1,700 sites just from a URL — YouTube in 4K, whole playlists and channels in one command, Instagram reels and stories, TikTok, Facebook, X, Twitch, or audio only as MP3. It is public domain, needs no app, account, or AI credits, runs entirely locally, and can simply be handed to Claude.
items.author: alassafi.ai

items.title: The EU AI Act sanctions that went live on 2 August
items.synopsis: Since Sunday 2 August, part of the EU AI Act carries active sanctions, so an app shipping AI features may already be non-compliant. The creator poses three questions to determine whether you fall in scope. A companion document is offered for bringing an app into compliance if you do.
items.author: laforet.dev

items.title: Draw a path on an image and make the camera follow it
items.synopsis: The creator demonstrates drawing directly on an image to define a path that the camera then follows through the generated shot. The technique is shown alongside a Higgsfield promotion offering Seedance 2.0 in 4K with two days of unlimited generation. A further seven days of unlimited Seedance 2.5 in 4K is announced for when that model lands on the platform.
items.author: jadheshvp

items.title: Italian AI prompt pack teased for comment delivery
items.synopsis: An Italian-language post offering a free complete prompt pack in exchange for a comment. The visible caption carries only trend hashtags and no description of the pack contents.
items.author: akapepinho

items.title: Three free AI websites for cartoon video, model comparison, and image variations
items.synopsis: The creator argues against paying for AI tools you barely use and presents three free alternatives. Between them they create cartoon videos, compare top AI models side by side, and generate dozens of image variations from a single prompt. All three are free to use.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: Wan2GP runs open-source AI video on a 6GB GPU
items.synopsis: Wan2GP is an open-source AI video generator built for people without cloud subscriptions or high-end hardware. It targets consumer GPUs, needing only about 6GB of VRAM to run. That puts it in reach of most mid-range NVIDIA cards from the past eight years.
items.author: karthikramaniai

items.title: A fabric-reveal fashion commercial from one product photo in under 60 seconds
items.synopsis: The creator contrasts clothing brands still paying for photo shoots that take weeks and cost heavily against a fabric-reveal commercial produced from a single product photo in under a minute. The process is to take your garment image, upload it to Google Flow, paste one specific prompt, and generate. The output is a premium fashion commercial showing off the garment's craftsmanship like a top-tier campaign.
items.author: keemfinity

items.title: Seedance 2.5 lands with 30-second single-take generation and native audio
items.synopsis: ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 generates continuous videos up to thirty seconds in a single generation while holding character, scene, and object consistency from start to finish. It accepts up to 50 reference images for people, products, brands, and environments, and allows editing a single detail without regenerating the whole video. Video and native audio are created together in one workflow, which the creator calls one of the biggest video model updates so far.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: A Spider-Man sequence generated entirely with Seedance 2.0
items.synopsis: Every web swing, gravity-defying movement, and cinematic transition in this sequence was generated with Seedance 2.0. The creator presents it as evidence the model turns simple ideas into blockbuster-style sequences. The result is described as dynamic, energetic, and unusually smooth.
items.author: fetoaciatania

items.title: Seedance 2.5 coming to Higgsfield with unlimited promo
items.synopsis: Higgsfield announces that Seedance 2.5 is coming soon to its platform. The launch offer bundles 14 days of unlimited Seedance, starting with 7 days of unlimited Seedance 2.0 in 4K, billed as the most premium Seedance model. Users can then switch to any other Seedance model for 7 more days.
items.author: higgsfield.ai

items.title: DeeVid AI Viral Studio one-click Spider-Man trend
items.synopsis: DeeVid AI promotes its Viral Studio feature riding the Spider-Man transformation trend flooding feeds. Users upload a single photo and the tool composites them into the suit, pose, and city-skyline backdrop built around their own face. Access to the link is gated behind commenting the word SPIDER.
items.author: deevidai

items.title: A single dashboard offering unlimited free image and video generation
items.synopsis: Pitched explicitly as a reason to stop paying for Higgsfield, this site provides unlimited AI image and video generation at no cost. You open it, paste a prompt, and it instantly produces high-quality images and videos ready to download with no watermarks and no generation limits. The creator's main selling point is direct access to every premium AI model from one dashboard, with the ability to tweak details and switch models freely.
items.author: lenabrooks.ai

items.title: A free local AI video generator with sound effects built in
items.synopsis: Responding to repeated requests for a free AI video generator, the creator settled on this open-source one that runs offline on your own machine with no limits and no cost. You feed it a single image or one line of text and it returns a smooth cinematic clip with sound effects included. From there you can add visual effects, move the camera, switch the style and reshape the scene as you like.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: Character sheets fix AI face drift between video shots
items.synopsis: The creator addresses the common failure where AI-generated characters change faces between shots when a scene is thrown directly at a video model. His fix is to build a character sheet before animating, using a node-based AI canvas with an image node dedicated to the character. The full workflow breakdown is gated behind a comment-to-DM funnel.
items.author: mr.evansugo

items.title: Seven days of unlimited Higgsfield across Gemini OMNI Flash, Seedance 2.0 and Nano Banana Pro
items.synopsis: The creator promotes a one-day offer giving seven days of unlimited access to Higgsfield's top models. The visuals shown were made with Gemini OMNI Flash, but the plan also covers Seedance 2.0 and Nano Banana Pro. The offer advertises unlimited AI generation and unlimited cinematic video across all top models.
items.author: johngoldcreates

items.title: Overgrown, Blender's new open movie made with and about Blender
items.synopsis: The creator introduces Overgrown, a new Blender feature film made in Blender, about Blender, and by the Blender community. Beyond the film itself, the project is set to share techniques for people who want to do animation without spending a fortune. The video encourages supporting the project and cites Blender Studio, Digital Production, BlenderNation, and Reddit as sources.
items.author: keyyzako

items.title: Google Vids: free all-in-one AI video creation tool
items.synopsis: The post announces that Google released a free AI video tool, identified by hashtags as Google Vids, that creates full videos without limits. It generates scenes from text and combines AI avatars, voiceovers, images, and music with editing in a single place. The link is distributed through a comment-to-DM mechanic.
items.author: sebintel

items.title: Higgsfield 1-day free trial with unlimited model access
items.synopsis: Higgsfield announces that all new users get a 1-day free trial with unlimited access to every top model on the platform. After the 24-hour trial the subscription auto-renews to the Plus tier, unlocking 7 more days of unlimited access. The signup link is gated behind commenting FREE.
items.author: higgsfield.ai

items.title: Claude edits a full video with no timeline or keyframes
items.synopsis: This French creator claims the video was never opened in an editing suite, with no timeline or hand-placed keyframes. He simply described the desired result and Claude performed the entire edit, which he frames as removing the traditional barrier of not knowing how to edit. His full system guide is delivered via DM to those commenting MONTAGE.
items.author: lemondedumarketing

items.title: A Vox-style explainer built by one Claude Skill
items.synopsis: The creator produced an entire Vox-style explainer video from a single prompt using only Claude Code and Higgsfield. No script was written, no scene storyboarded and After Effects never opened. One Claude Skill handled research, voiceover and every on-screen visual, and the video walks the workflow step by step.
items.author: sanji.chien

items.title: Free Claude skill replaces the multi-cam editing setup
items.synopsis: The creator claims AI has killed the multi-cam setup and has packaged the entire workflow into a free Claude skill. The skill transcribes your video, detects speech beats, and writes the full editing prompt automatically. The template and complete workflow are sent via DM to anyone commenting EDIT.
items.author: pauloshimas

items.title: Claude can finally see your videos, says Dev Watch host
items.synopsis: This French dev-content creator announces that Anthropic's Claude can now watch and understand videos, calling it a game changer. The clip is part of his Dev Watch podcast series built on GitHub repos he scans weekly. Commenting REPO gets viewers the full list of repositories he reviewed that week.
items.author: sebastien_heilig

items.title: AI lip sync onto any video using Seedance
items.synopsis: The post teaches how to lip sync onto any existing video with AI, with the Seedance hashtag identifying the underlying model. It targets creators wanting to retrofit dialogue or voiceover onto arbitrary footage. The tool link is delivered via DM after commenting AI.
items.author: rourke

items.title: Apple-style scroll-linked product animations in four no-code steps
items.synopsis: The creator reproduces the scroll-driven animations agencies charge thousands for — where a product spins or assembles itself as you scroll — in four steps with zero code. You generate a start frame and an end frame in Google Flow, use its frames-to-video mode to animate everything in between, then run that clip through EasyGIF's video-to-image-sequence tool at 30 frames per second and download the frames as a zip. Finally you drop the whole folder into your AI coding tool and ask it to build a scroll-linked image sequence on a canvas, which she notes is exactly the trick Apple uses on its product pages.
items.author: cindiezhu

items.title: Making an animated film with Claude
items.synopsis: This French creator showcases an animated film made with Claude and offers the full prompt and guide free via DM. The comment trigger is the word ANIME and he asks his audience what they think of Claude. The post positions Claude as a viable engine for end-to-end animated filmmaking.
items.author: yonak.ia

items.title: Weekly list of 12 Claude Code GitHub repos
items.synopsis: This French creator curates 12 GitHub repositories he analyzes every week, with hashtags pointing to Claude, Claude Code, and AI skills. The complete list is free and delivered via DM after commenting REPO, which also enrolls viewers in his newsletter. The video itself is a teaser for this recurring repo watch.
items.author: sebastien_heilig

items.title: Free repo lets Claude watch and analyze any video URL
items.synopsis: The post argues that AI could never truly watch a video until now, and that this changes content creation. A free repository lets users paste any video URL so Claude can analyze it, for example to explain what makes a video go viral instead of guessing. Full details are sent via DM after commenting VIDEO.
items.author: theaisurfer

items.title: Gemini Omni Flash video editing arrives on Higgsfield
items.synopsis: Higgsfield declares the Nano Banana era has reached AI video with Gemini Omni Flash, billed as the fastest and most efficient model for social media creators. It changes backgrounds, objects, and graphics in existing videos in minutes. The prompts are shared via DM to users commenting OMNI.
items.author: higgsfield.ai

items.title: An open-source agent that mass-creates Google accounts, and the grey market for them
items.synopsis: The creator acknowledges up front that what he is describing looks — and may partly be — illegal: a free open-source GitHub repo that deploys, in a single command, a system where a dedicated AI agent creates Google accounts en masse. The agent is built to pass as human with small delays and, he claims, bypasses all verification including phone checks, while a control dashboard stores and records every account and a retry process handles failures. He frames it as a business in itself given that people already pay for such accounts, and gates the link behind his paid community.
items.author: axel.devlopia

items.title: GPT Image 2.0 storyboard to Seedance 2.0 video workflow
items.synopsis: The creator details a four-step pipeline: build a character sheet and a location sheet with GPT Image 2.0 from reference images, generate a storyboard from both, then feed all three as references into Seedance 2.0 for video. The approach locks character and location consistency before any animation happens. He directs viewers to artlist.io for assets.
items.author: benkaluza

items.title: Free open-source Higgsfield alternative nears 20k stars
items.synopsis: This French post spotlights a free open-source alternative to Higgsfield that is exploding on GitHub, approaching 20,000 stars. The project provides access to over 200 AI models covering image generation, video, lip sync, and avatars, plus features inspired by Higgsfield's viral Cinema Studio. The video walks through what the project offers.
items.author: danyltn

items.title: Cancelling a $99 Higgsfield plan for a free Claude skill
items.synopsis: The creator cancelled his Higgsfield account and built a Claude skill instead, which he says does 90% of what Higgsfield promises — generating images, generating videos, and even upscaling video. Rather than paying around $99 a month he now pays pennies per generation, all from inside Claude. The skill also rewrites his rough prompt into a stronger one so results come out dialled in every time.
items.author: systemsbyvic

items.title: La DGX Station sous Windows, station de travail pour développeurs LLM
items.synopsis: Le post détaille les caractéristiques d'une DGX Station tournant sous Windows : 768 Go de mémoire, la capacité de charger un modèle à mille milliards de paramètres, 20 pétaflops de calcul et 8 To/s de bande passante. Le positionnement est explicitement celui des développeurs de LLM et d'agents. La légende se limite aux spécifications, sans prix ni retour d'usage.
items.author: quantumliaison

items.title: A $43k-a-month autonomous AI virtual model run from four markdown files
items.synopsis: The post analyses how a 21-year-old student built a fully autonomous AI virtual model that generated roughly $43,000 in thirty days with no creative team, camera gear, studio, or real human face, running off a single laptop at about $400 a month. The described architecture treats a subscription profile as a closed-loop software pipeline rather than manual production, applying data engineering thinking to creator-economy management. Human identity is decomposed into four modular configuration files: persona.md for the psychological profile, voice.md for the acoustic signature, flux.md for the visual anchor, and brain.md for memory and contextual behaviour during subscriber chat.
items.author: thesaar.ai

items.title: Retro Barbie lipsync videos via Higgsfield and Claude
items.synopsis: The creator reverse-engineers the trending vintage Barbie-doll lipsync reels popularized by plasticdreamsequence. His tutorial shows how to turn your own lipsync videos into plastic-doll retro clips without writing prompts, just by chatting with Higgsfield through its Claude integration. It is a concrete example of conversational AI driving a video platform.
items.author: stevenwommack

items.title: The omni-reference trick behind a €2,094 AI animated short
items.synopsis: A client paid the creator €2,094 for an animated film despite his never having learned animation, so he generated all of it with AI — and his key point is that generating scene by scene and hoping for coherence simply does not work. You first lock the style, here borrowed from Seven Deadly Sins and Ranking of Kings, and define characters and sets before the very first generation. The technique nobody uses is omni-reference: you generate a scene, take the last frame of that generation, and make it the reference for the next scene so characters, objects and set all continue from where the previous one stopped; he recommends Seedance 2.0 for the animation and Premiere Pro for the edit.
items.author: slowdoown

items.title: Un générateur vidéo open source sans crédits ni limite d'usage
items.synopsis: L'auteur oppose les outils vidéo classiques, qui offrent cinq crédits gratuits avant de facturer, à un modèle entièrement open source, illimité et gratuit. Il convertit une image ou un prompt texte en vidéo cinématographique fluide avec effets sonores, et permet d'ajouter des effets, de contrôler les mouvements de caméra et de changer de style. Étant ouvert, il peut tourner hors ligne et être utilisé autant de fois que voulu, le nom du modèle restant réservé au DM.
items.author: marktalksai

items.title: Waver, l'outil vidéo chinois gratuit présenté comme meilleur que Sora
items.synopsis: Le post annonce Waver, un générateur vidéo gratuit venu de Chine, comme détrônant Sora. Les qualités mises en avant sont des mouvements fluides, des personnages cohérents et un rendu cinématographique, avec l'affirmation que certains résultats dépassent déjà Sora, Kling ou Midjourney. La comparaison reste déclarative et le lien passe par un commentaire.
items.author: ia.boss.officiel

items.title: Pippit lance un agent IA de série courte propulsé par Dreamina Seedance 2.0
items.synopsis: Un épisode entier est généré par une seule IA à partir d'un unique script, via le premier agent de Short Drama lancé par Pippit. Les capacités annoncées sont des scripts allant jusqu'à 100 000 mots, des personnages qui restent cohérents du premier au dernier plan, et une réduction de 90 % des coûts de production. L'argument est celui d'un studio complet réduit à un agent, l'accès étant proposé par DM.
items.author: antony_nonis

items.title: video-use : un skill Claude Code qui monte les rushes en final.mp4
items.synopsis: Le workflow décrit tient en une phrase : déposer les rushes dans un dossier, dialoguer avec Claude Code, récupérer le montage final. Le skill video-use, publié par un développeur solo, transcrit tout ce qui a été dit, coupe les hésitations et les faux départs, supprime les temps morts entre les prises et étalonne chaque segment selon plusieurs partis pris colorimétriques. L'intérêt revendiqué est l'absence totale de préréglages, de menus et de timeline à manipuler.
items.author: wassimyounes_

items.title: Gemini Omni, le premier vrai éditeur vidéo IA de Google
items.synopsis: Le post annonce Gemini Omni comme le premier véritable éditeur vidéo piloté par IA. Trois capacités sont détaillées : ajouter ou retirer des objets dans une vidéo réelle, créer des avatars qui conservent le visage et la voix exacts de l'utilisateur d'une scène à l'autre, et transférer automatiquement un style de référence sur toute une vidéo. L'auteur y voit le workflow que les créateurs attendaient, l'accès passant par un commentaire.
items.author: sebastien

items.title: One photo plus a few seconds of voice becomes a lifelike talking video
items.synopsis: This open-source and completely free Chinese tool generates ultra-realistic video with very high facial quality from a single uploaded photo and a few seconds of recorded voice. The output shows the person speaking naturally with lip sync that matches precisely, believable facial expressions, and a cinematic look. You can then edit the whole scene by typing a prompt — asking to put them in a suit on a yacht rebuilds the scene while preserving the same face and identity.
items.author: lisaworldverse

items.title: Une romance d'ascenseur qui vire au chaos, réalisée avec Seedance 2.0
items.synopsis: Démonstration narrative produite avec Seedance 2.0, une scène de tension romantique dans un ascenseur qui bascule dans le chaos. L'accent est mis sur la capacité du modèle à tenir une dramaturgie, des émotions et des retournements dans un plan unique. Le gabarit de prompt complet est envoyé en DM sur commentaire.
items.author: sebintel

items.title: SkyReels-V2, générations vidéo illimitées en local et open source
items.synopsis: Le post présente SkyReels-V2, un modèle vidéo entièrement open source qui convertit une image ou un prompt texte en séquence cinématographique fluide. Il génère aussi des effets sonores porteurs d'émotion et tourne hors ligne sur la machine de l'utilisateur. L'argument différenciant est la durée : là où Veo 3 plafonne à quelques secondes et où Kling facture au clip, celui-ci vise des vidéos de longueur illimitée.
items.author: kayvon.ai

items.title: Du storyboard GPT Image 2.0 à l'animation Seedance 2.0
items.synopsis: Tutoriel qui donne le gabarit de prompt complet pour produire un storyboard exploitable : une grille de douze cases séparées par de fins liseraés noirs, chaque panneau numéroté en gras sans empattement dans le coin supérieur gauche et légendé d'une courte description du mouvement. Le style demandé est une animation picturale très détaillée inspirée d'Arcane, avec éclairage cinématographique, ombres marquées, coups de pinceau texturés et réalisme stylisé. Le storyboard sert ensuite d'entrée pour l'animation dans Seedance 2.0.
items.author: benkaluza.tech

items.title: Vidéo IA de quatre minutes, open source et hors ligne, sans crédits
items.synopsis: Reprise du même argumentaire que le post précédent du créateur : pas de limite à huit secondes, pas de crédits à acheter, pas de cloud. Le modèle mis en avant est open source, tourne hors ligne et produit des vidéos complètes de quatre minutes. Le nom du modèle reste réservé au DM déclenché par un commentaire.
items.author: thechriscordero

items.title: Générer vidéos et images gratuitement avec Pinokio et Wan2GP
items.synopsis: Post en français sur l'accès à des IA génératives sans abonnement payant. Les hashtags identifient la piste suivie : Pinokio comme lanceur d'applications open source et Wan2GP pour la génération vidéo en local. La légende reste une accroche, la procédure détaillée se trouvant dans la vidéo.
items.author: unefille.ia

items.title: Prompts et astuces de réalisation de films, distribués en DM
items.synopsis: Le post propose d'envoyer gratuitement en message privé les prompts et astuces employés pour réaliser le type de film montré. La seule information de fond est une question à l'audience sur l'usage de Claude. Aucun outil ni méthode n'est décrit dans la légende.
items.author: yonak.ia

items.title: Higgsfield, Claude Cowork et Meta assemblés en machine publicitaire autonome
items.synopsis: Montage en français décrivant un agent unique branché sur deux serveurs MCP pour faire tourner seule toute une chaîne de publicité Meta. Le cycle enchaîne recherche concurrentielle, génération de créas avec Sora 2, Veo et Kling, lancement des annonces sur Meta puis montée en charge sur les créas performantes. L'argument de vente est que l'ensemble s'exécute pendant que l'utilisateur dort, le guide complet passant par un commentaire.
items.author: pierrevibesai

items.title: Un rendu vidéo sans montage de niveau studio, prompts partagés sur Telegram
items.synopsis: Publication en russe soulignant que le résultat montré ne demande pas de montage professionnel et peut être reproduit avec son propre visage, un personnage ou un mannequin. L'autrice indique avoir déposé l'ensemble des prompts, des références et le workflow complet sur son canal Telegram, lié en bio. Le post invite à sauvegarder et à partager, notamment auprès de ceux qui associent encore l'IA à des vidéos ratées.
items.author: leerochhka

items.title: Higgsfield CLI génère du contenu en autonomie depuis le terminal
items.synopsis: Higgsfield annonce une interface en ligne de commande qui produit du contenu de façon autonome, sans écrire de code. Elle est conçue pour se coupler à des agents de développement comme Claude Code, Codex ou OpenCode. L'argument commercial est qu'une fois configurée, la chaîne continue de générer pendant que l'utilisateur dort, l'instruction complète étant envoyée par DM.
items.author: higgsfield.ai

items.title: Three free unlimited creator tools: Meta AI, Perchance, and a motion-transfer site
items.synopsis: The creator claims he was banned from three creator groups for sharing these free, unlimited tools and shares them anyway. Meta AI produces cinematic video from a single sentence and returns four results instantly, while Perchance AI generates 32 images from one click rather than three or ten. The third uploads your video and transfers your motion onto any celebrity or character, mapping your movements to their face, and he offers a further list of 47 lesser-known tools.
items.author: marktalksai

items.title: Un pipeline UGC entièrement piloté par Claude Code et Higgsfield
items.synopsis: L'auteur montre une chaîne où Claude Code génère des vidéos UGC à son effigie sans qu'il intervienne, en s'appuyant sur Seedance 2.0 hébergé chez Higgsfield. Le montage technique est explicite : on ajoute le MCP Playwright à Claude Code, plus une quinzaine de skills dédiés à Seedance 2.0, après quoi Claude rédige les prompts, téléverse les photos, pilote le navigateur et clique sur générer. Il présente le résultat comme un pipeline répétable suffisant pour faire tourner une activité UGC complète.
items.author: buildwithneej

items.title: Un outil unique pour script, visuels, voix et montage
items.synopsis: Le post annonce un outil IA présenté comme remplaçant l'ensemble de la chaîne de production vidéo. Les quatre étapes couvertes sont énumérées : script, visuels, voix et montage, réunies au même endroit. Aucun nom de produit ni démonstration n'apparaît dans la légende, le lien passant par un commentaire.
items.author: heyalav

items.title: Un modèle vidéo open source qui produit quatre minutes en local
items.synopsis: Le post met en avant un modèle vidéo capable de générer des séquences de quatre minutes, là où la plupart plafonnent à huit secondes. Les qualités revendiquées sont un mouvement stable, des déplacements de caméra crédibles, une physique réaliste et des personnages cohérents dans la durée. Le modèle tourne hors ligne sur la machine de l'utilisateur, sans limite d'usage, mais son nom est réservé au DM.
items.author: thechriscordero

items.title: Seedance 2.0 disponible dans Runway
items.synopsis: Annonce de la mise en ligne du modèle Seedance 2.0 sur Runway, accompagnée d'un lien d'accès direct. Le texte est surtout un propos de créateur sur l'écart qui se réduit entre les idées de films qu'on garde en tête et ce qu'on peut réellement produire, budget et temps ayant longtemps servi de plafond. La publication mêle donc annonce produit et témoignage sur la baisse des barrières à la création vidéo.
items.author: michalkuzminskii

items.title: A five-tool chain for AI avatars selling on TikTok Shop
items.synopsis: The workflow is shown as a rapid chain: take a prompt to ChatGPT, pick a reference image on Pinterest, add your image and generate; move to Nano Banana Pro, paste a second prompt and download your avatar. That avatar image plus an audio track goes into an agent that generates the talking video — demonstrated here as a perfume ad urging viewers to tap the orange cart. The finished clip is uploaded to TikTok to chase views and TikTok Shop commissions, with the full guide offered in DM.
items.author: seraphin.mp

items.title: Claude + Stitch for production-ready UI systems
items.synopsis: The post tackles Claude's historical weakness at frontend work by pairing it with Stitch, Google's UI generation tool. The workflow uses Stitch to generate full UI systems and then turns them into production-ready apps with animations and connected screens. The full setup and prompts are gated behind a 'Code' comment.
items.author: sferro.ai

items.title: UI/UX Pro Max Skill + 21st.dev Magic Chat for Claude
items.synopsis: This French video shows how to turn Claude into a professional UI/UX designer capable of generating very clean websites. The setup has two steps: install the UI/UX Pro Max Skill, then add Magic Chat from 21st.dev to access a huge library of interface components. The result is pro-level web design produced directly by the agent.
items.author: danyltn

items.title: Claude 'Carousel Maker' project for viral posts
items.synopsis: The post shows how to create viral Instagram carousels in under 60 seconds using Claude. You set up a dedicated 'Carousel Maker' project, paste the provided prompt, and Claude generates the slides, hooks, and content. The prompt itself is gated behind a 'Viral' comment.
items.author: lisaworldverse

items.title: A web-design tool that hands you the prompt, not just the page
items.synopsis: The creator presents a new web-coding tool that has taken the top spot for website design, generating clean professional layouts with modern gradients and fluid animations, entirely free. What impressed him is that it does not stop at the finished result — it also gives you the exact prompt used to create it. You take that prompt straight into Cursor or a similar builder and can modify the design instantly from there.
items.author: levibecodeur

items.title: Claude Code as a full website-design replacement
items.synopsis: A designer with 10+ years of experience claims Claude Code has replaced website designers, calling it the biggest shift he has seen. Work that used to cost thousands and take days now reportedly happens in seconds. He offers a stack guide for building high-quality websites with this AI workflow.
items.author: simon.saysai

items.title: An AI site builder generating immersive 3D scroll experiences from one prompt
items.synopsis: The creator positions this new AI website builder against Lovable, arguing that other vibe-coding tools produce clean but flat landing pages. This one instead generates a fully immersive 3D scroll-based site with real depth, real motion, and interactive elements that respond as you scroll. You describe the site in a single prompt and it builds the interactive 3D experience automatically.
items.author: sebintel

items.title: A GitHub repo of design prompts that transform NotebookLM slide decks
items.synopsis: The creator argues NotebookLM's default slide output is merely fine, and that getting genuinely striking decks requires strong design prompts. He points to a GitHub repository holding dozens of design prompts that completely change the look of NotebookLM slides. The link is offered to commenters.
items.author: devinkarpes

items.title: A comedy 'worst of the internet' PowerPoint about piracy repos on GitHub
items.synopsis: This is a French humour reel presenting a mock PowerPoint of the internet's worst offenders, selected for having contributed to large companies losing money. The joke is that typing each handle plus 'GitHub' surfaces their projects: one accused of developing a tool for free YouTube Premium on TV, another involved in a project granting the Adobe suite for free, and a third behind free access to the Office suite. The creator's running gag is mock outrage that they have all pinned these projects on their profiles.
items.author: madameb0nplan

items.title: EIC Pathfinder: up to 4M euros of EU money, zero equity
items.synopsis: The video spotlights the EU's EIC Pathfinder programme, which grants founders up to 4 million euros that never has to be repaid and takes 0% equity. Eligible themes include AI, longevity, and clean energy. This year's round is still open with a deadline of 28 October, and the creator offers the official page to commenters.
items.author: nikolai.pov

items.title: The omni-reference trick behind a €2,094 AI animated short
items.synopsis: A client paid the creator €2,094 for an animated film despite his never having learned animation, so he generated all of it with AI — and his key point is that generating scene by scene and hoping for coherence simply does not work. You first lock the style, here borrowed from Seven Deadly Sins and Ranking of Kings, and define characters and sets before the very first generation. The technique nobody uses is omni-reference: you generate a scene, take the last frame of that generation, and make it the reference for the next scene so characters, objects and set all continue from where the previous one stopped; he recommends Seedance 2.0 for the animation and Premiere Pro for the edit.
items.author: slowdoown

items.title: Microsoft's Legal Agent in Word and the 18-month clock
items.synopsis: The Microsoft AI CEO gives white-collar jobs 18 months before AI starts automating them massively, and Microsoft has just launched its Legal Agent inside Word. The video draws a striking parallel with coding: tools like Cursor and Claude began by suggesting code and now develop autonomously. The implication is that legal work is about to follow the same automation curve.
items.author: iam_romeobach

items.title: xAI Voice Agents let AI place real phone calls
items.synopsis: xAI Voice Agents move AI agents from messaging into placing actual phone calls, configured by describing the desired behaviour in plain language. You choose the script and voice, get a phone number, and test before calling for real. A real-time speech-to-speech pipeline keeps latency low and can switch languages mid-conversation, targeting lead qualification and appointment booking.
items.author: thevibefounder

items.title: Five small details that make an AI avatar read as real
items.synopsis: The creator's recurring finding is that avatar realism is never one big thing but an accumulation of tiny details. The five she watches most are skin, eyes, lighting and the small imperfections a real photograph would contain. An example prompt accompanies the breakdown so the difference is visible rather than described.
items.author: carrieparker.ai

items.title: Free open-source alternative to HeyGen avatars
items.synopsis: An open-source tool generates highly realistic AI avatars from a single photo plus an audio file. The creator positions it directly against HeyGen, with the difference being that it costs nothing. The video walks through what the tool produces before offering the links.
items.author: ia.boss.officiel

items.title: Character sheet prompts for consistent AI figures
items.synopsis: The account shares a set of character-sheet prompts for generating consistent figures across poses and views. The prompts are distributed to commenters. The account publishes regular AI prompt tips.
items.author: prompty.ai

items.title: Why AI photos look fake — and the realism layer that fixes it
items.synopsis: The creator argues that AI images look fake because of the prompt, not the model, and demonstrates with an image made in Arcads using GPT Image 2. Instead of simple descriptions he specifies exactly how a real photograph behaves — real camera settings, natural lighting, lifestyle framing — then adds a realism layer calling out visible pores, peach fuzz, baby hairs, subtle freckles, skin texture, fine wrinkles, natural lip texture, soft redness, and the tiny imperfections real cameras capture. A final pass through Skin Enhancer restores natural texture and removes the plastic AI look.
items.author: ai.akshu

items.title: Postiz: self-hosted social scheduling with an agent CLI
items.synopsis: Postiz is an open-source social media manager at roughly 30,000 GitHub stars that schedules posting across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn from one calendar. What Buffer cannot match is its agent CLI: you point Claude at it and tell it to schedule a week, and it drafts and queues the posts without opening a dashboard. Analytics, AI writing and a public API for n8n, Make or Zapier are included, and the self-hosted build is feature-complete and free.
items.author: brodyautomates

items.title: A free unrestricted Chinese image generator
items.synopsis: The creator presents a newly released free Chinese image tool he claims is more powerful than existing generators and ships with no content restrictions or filters. Usage is straightforward: go to the site, type your prompt, adjust a few settings and generate. He reports the output comes out sharper, more detailed and more realistic than most paid tools.
items.author: theaisurfer

items.title: InVideo Agent One Builds Full Cinematic Ads from a Brief
items.synopsis: The creator presents InVideo Agent One as a video editing agent that killed prompt engineering by following a professional production process instead of one-shot generation. From a simple creative reference it produced a GTA-style bug spray ad complete with character design, storyboards, moodboards, and game-world scenes. The link is delivered by commenting AI, positioning agentic ad production as the next step past clip generators.
items.author: nomadatoast

items.title: ElevenAgents Templates: Build an AI Agent in 60 Seconds
items.synopsis: This sponsored ElevenLabs post shows that the easiest way to build an AI agent is starting from a pre-built ElevenAgents template. Setup takes under sixty seconds and templates exist for nearly every use case, with no vibe coding required. Details are sent by DM after commenting agent.
items.author: bigpictureclub_

items.title: Pinterest to JSON prompt to Flow: an AI avatar pipeline
items.synopsis: The creator finds an avatar style he likes on Pinterest, copies the image, and asks ChatGPT to break it down in extreme detail into a JSON prompt. He copies that generated JSON prompt into a new chat, chooses image creation at 9:16, pastes it in, and gets his initial AI avatar image. That image is then uploaded into flow.com, where he sets up the image at 9:16 to carry the avatar into video generation.
items.author: dawoodzahidai

items.title: 6 Reference Boards Every AI Filmmaker Needs
items.synopsis: The carousel presents six reference boards as the underused secret weapon of AI filmmaking. They include a twelve-shot storyboard built from one image, a full character bible, a location board with time of day and weather, and a pose board for animation. The technique treats consistency and cinematic quality as a pre-production planning problem.
items.author: ai.withphil

items.title: Yamamoto Streetwear Concept with Multi-Angle Consistency
items.synopsis: The creator reimagines Bleach's Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto in a gritty modern streetwear look. The key achievement is keeping the character's intense, battle-hardened appearance consistent across different camera angles, a task that used to be difficult. The exact prompt is offered by DM after commenting OLDMAN, and the author's sibling posts use the SeaArt platform for this workflow.
items.author: riowmartha

items.title: Seedance 2.0 + GPT Image 2.0 on SeaArt for Rukia Look
items.synopsis: The creator finally nails a realistic street-style version of Bleach's Rukia Kuchiki using the Seedance 2.0 and GPT Image 2.0 combo on SeaArt. The workflow solves the classic problem of keeping AI characters consistent across different camera angles. The full workflow and prompt are shared by DM after commenting RUKIA.
items.author: riowmartha

items.title: A free local ElevenLabs replacement with context-aware synthesis
items.synopsis: The creator declares the end of ElevenLabs, presenting a local, free and unlimited replacement he says gives nothing away to the original. It supports over 30 languages, clones your own voice, delivers high audio quality, and — the feature he stresses most — takes context into account during synthesis. It installs simply and connects to any of your solutions, which he notes suits anyone deploying voice-driven builds through Claude Code.
items.author: its.abdechan

items.title: An AI that builds entire YouTube channels, including hour-long documentaries
items.synopsis: The creator presents what he calls the first AI able to turn written information into documentaries running over an hour. You give it a video idea and it researches the subject, writes the full script, and scans the internet for real footage matching the story, automatically generating animations to fill any gaps where suitable clips do not exist. It then layers in voiceover, sound effects, transitions and music to assemble the finished video.
items.author: ugotatas.ia

items.title: Imperfection Detail Makes AI Avatars Read as Real
items.synopsis: The creator explains that realism in current AI portraits comes from what older models smoothed out: natural skin flaws, uneven tone, tiny freckles, and peach fuzz. The brain reads these imperfections as proof the photo is genuine. Micro-detail in the eye completes the illusion, with the full prompt set gated behind an AI comment.
items.author: bymaximade

items.title: Seedance 2.0 + Seedream 5.0 Single-Take Cinematic Scene
items.synopsis: The creator declares that AI has crossed into cinematic storytelling with a fifteen-second, single-take full transformation built on Seedance 2.0 and Seedream 5.0. No VFX team or studio was involved, only prompt control and timing. The framing is that the real shift is from generating clips to directing scenes, with the full prompt and workflow gated behind a MOON comment.
items.author: aswinajiraj.ai

items.title: A five-tool chain for AI avatars selling on TikTok Shop
items.synopsis: The workflow is shown as a rapid chain: take a prompt to ChatGPT, pick a reference image on Pinterest, add your image and generate; move to Nano Banana Pro, paste a second prompt and download your avatar. That avatar image plus an audio track goes into an agent that generates the talking video — demonstrated here as a perfume ad urging viewers to tap the orange cart. The finished clip is uploaded to TikTok to chase views and TikTok Shop commissions, with the full guide offered in DM.
items.author: seraphin.mp

items.title: Superscale AI Generates Human-Like Ads at Scale
items.synopsis: Superscale pitches its platform as a replacement for waiting on human influencers. Its AI creates scroll-stopping, human-like video ads in minutes, produced at scale and on demand. The value proposition targets performance marketers who need conversion-ready avatar creative without creator logistics.
items.author: getsuperscaleai

items.title: 22 design-system prompts for NotebookLM, now renamed Gemini Notebook
items.synopsis: Following a previous post on NotebookLM design prompts that drew over 20,000 comments, the creator has produced 22 more, noting in passing that Google has renamed NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook while the tool and prompts remain the same. Each prompt is a complete design system covering colours, fonts and even how the message is conveyed: Boy Band renders the deck as a 1990s album, Insert Coin as an 80s arcade game, Chalkboard as a physics lecture, Storybook as a bedtime story and Bauhaus as a 1920s art poster. You apply them inside your notebook by opening the slide deck, clicking the circle-with-arrow control, pasting the prompt into the block and hitting generate.
items.author: devinkarpes

items.title: A GitHub repo of design prompts that transform NotebookLM slide decks
items.synopsis: The creator argues NotebookLM's default slide output is merely fine, and that getting genuinely striking decks requires strong design prompts. He points to a GitHub repository holding dozens of design prompts that completely change the look of NotebookLM slides. The link is offered to commenters.
items.author: devinkarpes

items.title: Browser-Use: free open-source rival to AI browser agents
items.synopsis: While attention was on ChatGPT Agent and Claude Computer Use, a developer released Browser-Use, a free open-source framework that does almost the same thing. It lives on GitHub and lets an AI drive a web browser to complete tasks autonomously. The video pitches it as a game changer for virtual assistants and automation builders.
items.author: thevibefounder

items.title: ScrapeGraph AI does in free what Apify and Bright Data charge for
items.synopsis: An Italian developer released ScrapeGraph AI under an MIT licence, free forever, and it has already gathered 23,000 stars. You give it a URL and describe what you want in plain English, and the AI handles the rest — LinkedIn profiles, email addresses, Twitter accounts, Amazon, Zillow, Glassdoor — including multi-page scraping at scale. The creator's economic point is that Apify charges $49 a month and Bright Data $500, while agencies are already billing clients $5,000 per scraping project using this free tool.
items.author: criscatalyst

items.title: Scrapling: 800x faster scraper that dodges Cloudflare
items.synopsis: A French video promoting Scrapling, a scraper billed as 800 times faster than existing tools, installable in 30 seconds via Claude Code. It reportedly bypasses Cloudflare without detection, enabling claims like 10,000 leads in one night with zero banned IPs. It is presented as compatible with OpenAI Codex and other agent tooling.
items.author: just_use_ai_now

items.title: Install Scrapling in 30 seconds with Claude Code
items.synopsis: The pitch: hand Claude Code a GitHub link and 30 seconds later it has installed Scrapling, described as the most powerful scraping tool in the world. The tool claims to be 800 times faster than anything else and to get around Cloudflare protections. A free installation guide is offered to viewers who comment 'Scrap'.
items.author: bapt.autoai

items.title: ScrapeGraph-AI threatens paid scraping platforms
items.synopsis: A developer released ScrapeGraph-AI on GitHub, an open-source LLM-powered scraping tool that has already collected over 23,000 stars. The video claims it is replacing paid scraping platforms costing around 40,000 rupees a month. It frames the project as the moment free open-source AI killed the paid web-scraping market.
items.author: thevibefounder

items.title: 'Ultimate Web Scraper' Chrome extension demo
items.synopsis: A short demo naming the Chrome extension 'Ultimate Web Scraper' as the tool being showcased. The angle is no-code data extraction directly from the browser for automation, e-commerce, and productivity use cases. Details on capabilities are thin in the caption, but the tool itself is explicitly identified.
items.author: arthur.webscraping
